args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) in all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

- **Rollback:** Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions — status `rolled_out`.
- **Incident:** Opened SEV2 `INC-0002` for checkout-api, paging on-call, describing the health-check failure and the rollback performed.
